hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Track occurrence frequencies of all values in the original sequence.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Sort unique values primarily in descending order of frequency, and break ties by numerical magnitude.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Reconstruct the array by emitting each element repeated according to its frequency.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Frequency counting followed by frequency-value sorting and array reconstitution.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for most frequent elements takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary and output array scale linearly with input size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Aggregates frequencies and applies compound sorting key.
